columnWidth.description: Stretch side-by-side columns to fill the screen

chatOrder.description: Choose whether new chat messages appear at the bottom or the top

timeFormat.description: Show post times as dates or as time ago

clientTag.description: Marks your posts as sent from Streets. Other apps show something like “via Streets”, so anyone can see which app you use. The mark can't be removed from posts you have already sent.
clientTag.switch: Show that posts were sent from Streets

notifyQuoted.description: When you quote a post, its author gets a notification. If you turn this off, they aren't told you quoted them. This applies both to the quote button and to links to posts in your text. People you mention by name in the text are still notified.
notifyQuoted.switch: Notify the author of the post you quote

errorReport.description: Sends error details, along with how long screens and actions took to load, to the developers together with information about your device and browser. When signing or logging in fails, it also sends how you log in (the type of extension, and the relays used to talk to your signer). It never sends your private key, public key, event IDs or the text of your posts.
